title: How he got the name Happy
summary: A boyhood friend, a piano player named Tom, started calling him Happy because he was jolly and acted in concerts; he also played with Tom Benton.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: How did you get the name Happy? When did they start that?

Well, when I was a boy, a little kid, I used to always could, I always was a jolly. I used to play in concerts and different things, and I was acting. And so a boy, what he used to be, was he was the one who started to call me happy. And ever since that people called me happy all over the world.
Which boy was this? Was he a musician?
Yeah, he was a piano player. And he was, his name was Tom. Well, he did.
Is that Tom Benton? Did you know Tom Benton, by the way? You introduced me to Tom Benton.
